title: Audit of the classical saturated pool-boiling hydrodynamic CHF scaling
decision_or_claim: Determine what the classical Zuber-form scaling supports as a baseline and what evidence is still required before using it as a causal or predictive CHF model.
event_definition: Maximum sustained nucleate-boiling heat flux followed by an irreversible wall-temperature excursion under a declared quasi-static imposed-heat-flux protocol.
system_boundary: Macroscale upward-facing heater, saturated liquid pool, vapor structures, liquid-vapor interface, and gravity field; the reduced scaling does not resolve the conjugate heater or near-wall microlayer.

regime.description: Saturated, gravity-dominated pool boiling on a macroscale upward-facing surface with negligible imposed bulk flow.

geometry_and_frame: Horizontal upward-facing heated area of characteristic dimension L_h in a stationary laboratory frame; vertical gravity opposes vapor buoyancy.
materials_or_fluids: Pure or declared working fluid at saturation
Heater surface whose effects are not represented by the classical property group

operating_conditions.name: saturation pressure
operating_conditions.range: specified positive pressure away from an unexamined critical singularity

initial_conditions: Initially wetted saturated pool after a declared conditioning protocol; history dependence remains an applicability concern.
boundary_conditions: Quasi-static imposed heat-flux ramp on the heater
Far field large enough for the declared pool approximation
Gravity normal to the upward-facing surface

dependent_variables.name: critical heat flux
dependent_variables.definition: Heat flux at the declared boiling-crisis event

dependent_variables.name: dimensionless CHF
dependent_variables.definition: q''_CHF divided by the classical hydrodynamic property scale

governing_variables.name: body acceleration
governing_variables.sign_convention: Positive magnitude opposite vapor buoyancy direction

conservation_laws: Total mass transfer across the liquid-vapor interface
Momentum balance with gravity, inertia, pressure, and surface tension
Total energy balance connecting evaporation rate to heat input
source_and_sink_terms: Gravity supplies body force but not mass
Interphase mass/momentum/energy transfers cancel in the combined system

constitutive_closures.name: Classical Zuber coefficient convention
constitutive_closures.provenance: Zuber, AECU-4439, DOI 10.2172/4175511; exact source equation and convention must be checked
constitutive_closures.calibration_boundary: Do not refit pi/24 to target data and still call the result the classical baseline

frame_and_invariance: Stationary nonrelativistic laboratory frame; Galilean changes do not alter the property scale. Lorentz transformations are irrelevant because U/c is negligible.

reference_scales: hydrodynamic heat-flux scale h_fg rho_v^(1/2)[sigma g(rho_l-rho_v)]^(1/4)
ordering_parameters: Heater dimension relative to assumed hydrodynamic wavelength
scale_analysis.expected_reduction_error: Not supplied by the classical scaling as a universal bound; quantify empirically by fluid, pressure, heater size, surface, and facility holdouts.

assumptions: Property evaluation at one declared saturation state
Surface and conjugate-heater effects are secondary for the baseline
exclusions: Using the baseline as proof of a universal trigger
Mixing flow-boiling or dryout data into pool-boiling validation
Fitting the coefficient on validation cases
baselines: Zuber-form hydrodynamic property scaling with separately declared coefficient convention
calibration_boundary: The classical coefficient is fixed before comparison; any correction or surface factor defines a different calibrated model.
acceptance_criteria: Intermediate wavelength/growth prediction tested before causal attribution
Independent pool-boiling holdouts for predictive claims
falsification_cases: Observed dominant structure inconsistent with predicted hydrodynamic scale
Strong heater-size dependence not captured by L_h/lambda_RT,d
Surface or substrate intervention changes CHF while the bulk property scale remains nearly fixed
Failure on sealed cross-fluid or pressure cases
uncertainty_plan: Propagate covariance in h_fg, densities, surface tension, gravity, event detection, and heat flux; keep property and experimental uncertainty separate from model-form discrepancy.
benchmark_plan: Verify the source equation and coefficient convention
Use saturated pool-boiling data separated by fluid, pressure, surface, heater geometry, and laboratory
Compare predicted wavelength and intermediate topology before terminal CHF
provenance: Property starting source: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD 69
This example is an audit artifact, not new CHF evidence
